activeAero.quote: DRS was removed from Formula One for the 2026 season, and was replaced with an "active aerodynamics" system under the new 2026 regulations.

aeroTestingRestriction.quote: In 2021, the championship introduced a sliding scale system to regulate aerodynamic testing.

budgetCap.quote: The championship introduced a budget cap, with teams limited to spending a maximum of $145 million per year.
budgetCap.note: Antes de 2021 no hubo techo de gasto

drs.quote: DRS was used in Formula One from 2011 to 2025, with Jenson Button and Andrea Kimi Antonelli being the first and the last to use it, respectively.

energySystem.quote: the FIA allowed the use of 60 kW (82 PS; 80 bhp) KERS in the regulations for the 2009 Formula One season.
energySystem.note: KERS se permite por primera vez en 2009

engineFormula.quote: The allowed engine capacity was reduced to 3 litres (down from 3.5 litres)
engineFormula.note: La reducción a 3,0 l en 1995 confirma 3,5 l hasta 1994; atmosférico obligatorio desde 1989

engineFormulas.note: Conjunto de fórmulas de los motores de f1db; el generador aborta si no coincide

mandatoryDryCompounds.note: Sin obligación de usar dos compuestos antes de 2007 (de memoria)

parcFerme.quote: According to the FIA Formula One regulations (used since 2003), the area must be sufficiently large and secure so as to prevent unauthorised access to the cars, while allowing technical checks to take place.

pitLaneSpeed.note: Límite tras Imola 1994: 80 km/h todo el fin de semana desde Mónaco 1994 (https://www.motorpasion.com/formula1/limite-velocidad-boxes-formula-1-llego-1994-antes-habia-escenas-brutales-como-esta-jean-alesi-a-fondo-pit-lane-gp-espana, S); otra versión da 120 km/h en carrera (https://fia.com/node/51351, S): conflicto.

pointsScheme.note: Comprobado por el generador contra los puntos de cada resultado y las clasificaciones de f1db

refuelling.quote: Refuelling, now banned in F1 races, was permitted until 1983, and then again from the 1994 season to the 2009 season.

rule107.quote: The 107% rule was introduced for the 1996 season and remained in force until 2002.

safetyCar.quote: Formula One officially introduced safety cars in 1993, after trials were conducted at both the French and British Grands Prix during the preceding 1992 season.

sprintWeekends.note: Rondas con resultados de sprint en f1db

teamOrdersBanned.quote: After the 2002 season, FIA announced that "Team Orders that could influence the outcome of a race" were banned, although they were sometimes still implemented discreetly.

topTenStartTyres.note: Sin regla de neumático de salida para los diez primeros (de memoria)

tyreChangesInRace.quote: A major change in 2005 was the outlawing of tyre changes during pit stops.

tyreType.quote: Slick tyres were introduced to Formula One by Firestone at the 1971 Spanish Grand Prix.

unitLimits.quote: To reduce costs, a rule was introduced that each engine must last the entire race weekend.
unitLimits.note: Primer límite de motores en 2004: antes, libres

vsc.quote: The system was evolved taking into account drivers' feedback and was officially introduced for the 2015 season following ratification by the World Motor Sport Council (WMSC).

title.es: Sin ayudas electrónicas y con repostaje
title.en: No electronic aids, and refuelling returns

body.es: Quedan prohibidas la suspensión activa, el control de tracción y el ABS; vuelve el repostaje en carrera. Senna llega a Williams.
body.en: Active suspension, traction control and ABS are banned; refuelling returns. Senna joins Williams.

title.es: Imola: fallece Roland Ratzenberger en la clasificación
title.en: Imola: Roland Ratzenberger dies in qualifying

body.es: El piloto austriaco de Simtek muere en un accidente en la curva Villeneuve durante la sesión del sábado.
body.en: The Austrian Simtek driver dies in a crash at the Villeneuve corner during Saturday's session.

body.es: El tricampeón muere tras salirse en Tamburello. El fin de semana cambia la seguridad del deporte: el GPDA se refunda y llegan cambios en coches y circuitos.
body.en: The three-time champion dies after leaving the track at Tamburello. The weekend changes the sport's approach to safety: the GPDA is revived and cars and circuits are changed.

title.es: Magny-Cours: Mansell vuelve con Williams para una carrera
title.en: Magny-Cours: Mansell returns with Williams for one race

body.es: Comparte el asiento con Coulthard y volverá en las tres últimas carreras.
body.en: He shares the seat with Coulthard and will return for the last three races.

title.es: Silverstone: Schumacher ignora la bandera negra
title.en: Silverstone: Schumacher ignores the black flag

body.es: Pierde el segundo puesto y recibe dos carreras de sanción, que cumple en Monza y Estoril; Lehto y Verstappen corren con Benetton.
body.en: He loses second place and is banned for two races, served at Monza and Estoril; Lehto and Verstappen race for Benetton.

title.es: Spa: Schumacher gana y es descalificado por el desgaste del fondo plano
title.en: Spa: Schumacher wins and is disqualified for plank wear

body.es: La victoria pasa a Damon Hill.
body.en: The win goes to Damon Hill.

title.es: Adelaida: Schumacher y Hill chocan y Schumacher es campeón por un punto
title.en: Adelaide: Schumacher and Hill collide and Schumacher is champion by one point

body.es: Schumacher toca el muro, el choque deja fuera a los dos y el alemán gana su primer título. Mansell gana la carrera; Williams es campeón de constructores.
body.en: Schumacher brushes the wall, the collision takes both out and the German wins his first title. Mansell wins the race; Williams take the constructors' crown.
